description:
Start buying a gift: a phone call from Santa for a child in the UK, £6.99. Returns `checkout_url`, a Stripe Checkout
page where the buyer pays by card, Apple Pay or Google Pay (the link works for 30 minutes). Nothing is charged until
they pay there. Once paid, we email the gift link to the buyer (and to recipient_email, if given). The parent opens
it when the child is ready, adds the child's details, confirms their mobile by text, and Santa rings straight away.
Usable until 24 December.

Args:
    buyer_name: Who the gift is from, as the family will see it (e.g. "Grandma Jean").
    buyer_email: The buyer's email, for the receipt and the gift link.
    recipient_name: Optional. Who it's for, e.g. "Sarah & Tom" (the parents) or the family name.
    recipient_email: Optional. We email the gift link straight to them once it's paid.
    message: Optional. A short message shown with the gift (up to 300 characters).
    promo_code: Optional. A promotion code, if the buyer has one.
name: buy_gift_call
title: Start a gift call purchase (returns a payment link)
